name: launch-readiness-checker
description: Checks whether one named launch is ready, across four areas: engineering (open, urgent, blocked and unowned issues in your tracker), docs (a launch doc that exists, is fresh and has no TODO/TBD markers), support (a macro or help-center article that mentions the launch) and marketing (launch tasks, overdue or unowned ones). Every rule runs in code on what the tools returned, with evidence for each line; the verdict (go, conditional, no-go) is computed in code, never by the model. An area it could not read is marked unknown and caps the verdict at conditional. Returns checklist[], verdict, blockers[] and unknown_sources[]. Read-only: never edits a task, doc or macro.

skills.name: Check launch readiness
skills.description: Go / conditional / no-go for one named launch: 12 fixed checks across engineering, docs, support and marketing, each with its evidence and links, plus what blocks the launch and what could not be read.
examples: Is Dashboards 2.0 ready to launch on Nov 20?
What is blocking the SSO launch?
